items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: You had, also that 1974 Carnegie Hall appearance. You know. where you were questing with Sy Oliver's band? Right.

ctx.x: Cause he went down to you, he went down to Birmingham with me just a little bit before. He went in for a week, and then he went down to do this concert and come back. Cause, he had been with Sy for quite awhile, didn't he?
Right. And then, you know, a few years back, you know, when he left the studios to go out with Earl Hines.
